primary_risks: Public website route/deploy mismatch can send users to homepage instead of product, legal, or academy pages.
Payment checkout is not robust: Stripe key appears placeholder/invalid and server returns empty reply on Stripe 401 instead of controlled JSON error.
Public API routing is inconsistent: root-domain /api paths fall through to static homepage; api subdomain is behind Cloudflare Access, which blocks public checkout/API flow unless intentional.
PWP visual proof harness is present but currently not runnable until Playwright Chromium is installed/fixed in the Ned environment.

Generated bot PDFs need visual/brand/accessibility QA; current sample PDFs are valid but not text-accessible via pdftotext. Typical wkhtmltopdf nonsense, but still needs fixing if we care about polish.
